concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-address-find-node]] - Node.js lookup of one address by customer ID plus address ID, with `err`/`address` callback evidence, separate response-object navigation, and a shared customer-or-address not-found route
warnings: Preserve the argument identity and order shown by the page: customer ID first and address ID second; do not collapse them into a generic token or address-only lookup.
Do not infer fields on the callback's address value, a success flag, Promise behavior, or any other response schema from the callback parameter name.
Keep missing address and missing customer under the single linked notFoundError route; the page does not distinguish their error objects or outcomes.
Do not import address-ID generation, uniqueness, mutation, deletion, or payment-method effects from adjacent address operations into this lookup source.
